info.name: Yooz Rising Public API of your application : CertifAdminTRGWareenanBoonchan
info.description:
In order to use yooz public API you must logged in.

Oauth2 authentication password grant :
  • client_id: yooz-public-api
  • client_secret: let empty
  • username / password: your session login / password

Oauth2 authentication grant code :
  • client_id: yooz-stats
  • client_secret: let empty
You can get the swagger file here.

query.description: Precises the page offset to manage pagination. For example if you want the 3rd page of your pagination then you should precise pageOffset=2

Precises the page size to manage pagination. For example if you want page of 50 elements then you should precise pageSize=50. Pages are limited to 1000 elements. If there is no pageSize then we will take 1000

Precises the last execution datetime to use when there is a filter on the data report with the last execution datetime. If there is no last execution datetime then we will take the date precised in the database. This can be used if you need your values from a precise date and not from the true last execution datetime.
Format : UTC, like this '2023-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'

Precises the language for the data. If nothing is set then we will take the language of the user. This is mainly used for the excel addin.
Format : fr/es/en-GB/en-US

The "offset" parameter determines the starting point or position within the result set from where the API should begin returning data. It is used in combination with the "limit" parameter to implement pagination. item.name: Import a file.

header.description: (Required) The applicationId (representing yooz client) on which we want to communicate

formdata.description: (Required) File to import.
(Optional) - If set to true, will skip the duplicate file verification and will upload the file even if it is a duplicate. (if no value, it will be false)
(Optional) - Code of the organizational unit for the file.
(Optional) - Code of the document type for the file.

(Optional) - Precise the split mode to use. (if no value, it will be auto)
Values can be 'none', 'auto' or 'fixed'. (This can only be one of none,auto,fixed)
(Unsued if fixed is not precised in splitMode, otherwise it is required) - Precise the number of pages to cut per files.
(Optional) - Precise if a validation has to be done after splitting. (if no value, it will be false)
(Optional) - Document's name.
(Optional) - Code of the document's third.
(Optional) - Document's number.
(Optional) - Document's date. (format YYYY-MM-DD)
(Optional) - Document's due date. (format YYYY-MM-DD)
(Optional) - Document's amount.
(Optional) - Document's tax amount.
(Optional) - Document's total amount.
(Optional) - Code of the document's currency.
(Optional) - Document's exchange rate.
(Optional) - Document's description.
(Optional) - Document's reception date. (format YYYY-MM-DD)
(Optional) - Document's archive number.
(Optional) - Document's highlight color. (The format is an hex color code ex : #FF0F00)

(Optional) - Id of the document's confidentiality level.
Values can be -1/-2/-3/-4/-5/-6, -1 is the less confidential and -6 the more.
(Optional) - Date before the document has to be processed before flagging it as late. (format YYYY-MM-DD)
(Optional) - [(Required) when documentTypeCode is YZ_SALES_CREDIT] - Invoice numbers linked to this actual invoice, takes only one invoice number actually
